resources.string: PowerMenu Helper needs accessibility access solely to invoke system global actions on your behalf: opening the power menu (power off / restart) and locking the screen. It does NOT observe, collect or transmit any screen content. The service reads no events and stores nothing.
Please enable the accessibility service first.
Locking the screen requires Android 9 or above.
Reduce the load on your physical power button
Open the default system power menu to power off or restart — no more long-pressing the side key.
One tap to lock the screen, saving wear on the button.
Add the “Power Menu” tile to Quick Settings and trigger it from any screen.
2. Find PowerMenu Helper in the list and turn it on.
3. Come back and tap the buttons. Done.

This app works fully offline, has no internet permission, shows no ads and collects no data. The accessibility service is used only to perform global actions (power dialog / lock screen) at your request.
